Messages.Author: Trochomancy
Messages.Body:
What is the policy with deck lists in EC2017 tournaments?

- Are they required in all tournaments or only in main events Sat-Sun?
- If yes, are the organizers providing some template or is it ok if I bring the printed/hand written decklist to tournament?

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
It's up to the organizers but usually a deck list is required for that kind of events.
In any case, you can hand write it. Don't forget to put your name and VEKN number on it.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director

Messages.Author: Damnans
Messages.Body:
Decklists will be required in all tournaments.
